hook.es: Un sistema no tiene por qué existir solo para uno.
hook.en: A system doesn't have to exist for just one.

objective: The repeating pattern noticed in Episode 4 (IntCloudSysOps) gets a name and a shape: Opsly. The architecture forms in layers — Tenant, Blueprint, Modules, Events, Agents, Approvals, Metrics, Learning. This happens before any specific client world exists; Opsly is built as a way of building, not as one product for one client.

scenes.description: The pattern from Episode 4 gets a name
scenes.visuals: The faint glowing pattern from before condenses into a single word forming in light: OPSLY
scenes.copy: El patrón repetido, por fin, tuvo un nombre.

scenes.visuals: A vertical glowing structure forms layer by layer: Tenant, then Blueprint, then Modules, then Events, then Agents, then Approvals, then Metrics, then Learning — each layer snapping into place
scenes.copy: Tenant. Blueprint. Modules. Events. Agents. Approvals. Metrics. Learning.

scenes.visuals: The Traveler and NØVA looking up at the completed but still-empty structure — no tenant-world populates it yet
scenes.copy: Un sistema no tiene por qué existir solo para uno.

scenes.description: The Traveler connects it to Episode 2
scenes.visuals: Faint echo of the eight portal-worlds from Episode 2 flickering briefly behind The Traveler
scenes.copy: Quizás todas esas vidas anteriores no fueron dispersión. Fueron entrenamiento para entender esto.

scenes.description: Closing — waiting for its first world
scenes.visuals: The empty layered structure glowing quietly, waiting
scenes.copy: Un blueprint puede convertirse en muchos mundos. Todavía no tenía ninguno.

metadata.call_to_action: Un blueprint puede convertirse en muchos mundos.
